Initial release of SimpliSafe shell integration.

- Query and control a SimpliSafe alarm system using curl and jq.
- Read system state, sensors, locks, events, and settings.
- Arm/disarm the system and lock/unlock doors directly from the shell.
- Requires a one-time browser login to mint and save a refresh token.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, security notes, and verified endpoint references.
